title: System Administrator
description:
Below is a detailed Job Description (JD) for System Administrator suitable for Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited, covering corporate office and manufacturing locations. Job Description System Administrator Department: Information Technology (IT) Designation: System Administrator
 Department: IT / Information Technology
 Reporting To: IT Head / Management

 Experience: 37 Years
 Qualification: BCA / B.Sc. (IT/Computer Science) / B.Tech (IT/Computer Science) / MCA or equivalent. 1. Job Purpose To manage, maintain and ensure the smooth functioning of the company's IT infrastructure, including servers, computer systems, networks, internet connectivity, email systems, cybersecurity, hardware and software. The role will provide technical support to employees across corporate offices and manufacturing units. 2. Key Responsibilities A. IT Infrastructure & System Administration Manage and maintain Windows/Linux servers and operating systems. Install, configure and maintain desktops, laptops and printers. Monitor system performance and ensure maximum uptime. Manage user accounts, access permissions and password policies. Maintain Active Directory, domain controllers and Group Policies. Ensure regular data backup and disaster recovery procedures. B. Network & Internet Management Manage LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches and firewall configurations. Monitor internet connectivity across corporate and plant locations. Troubleshoot network issues and ensure secure connectivity. Coordinate with internet service providers and network vendors. Maintain VPN connectivity between corporate office and manufacturing units. C. IT Support & Troubleshooting Provide technical support to employees for hardware and software issues. Resolve problems related to desktops, laptops, printers, scanners and email. Install and configure operating systems and business applications. Maintain IT helpdesk and track support requests. Ensure timely resolution of IT-related complaints. D. Cybersecurity & Data Protection Implement antivirus and endpoint security solutions. Monitor firewall and network security. Ensure regular security updates and patch management. Protect company data against unauthorized access and cyber threats. Implement data backup, recovery and access control policies. E. Software & Application Management Manage Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Exchange email systems. Monitor software licences and renewals. Provide technical support for ERP, HRMIS, CRM and other business applications. Coordinate with software vendors for implementation and troubleshooting. Maintain software and hardware inventory. F. Vendor & Asset Management Coordinate with IT vendors for hardware purchases and repairs. Maintain records of IT assets, licences and warranties. Monitor IT AMC contracts and renewals. Ensure proper allocation and recovery of IT assets during employee joining and separation. G. Plant & Multi-location IT Support Provide IT support to all company offices and manufacturing locations. Ensure uninterrupted network and system connectivity at plants. Coordinate with local IT support personnel. Conduct periodic IT infrastructure audits. 3. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Linux. Hands-on experience in Active Directory and Office 365. Knowledge of networking protocols, TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP. Experience with routers, switches, firewalls and VPN. Knowledge of virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V). Understanding of cybersecurity and data protection. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills. 4. Experience Preference 3–7 years of relevant experience in System Administration. Experience in manufacturing companies or multi-location organisations will be preferred. Experience in managing IT infrastructure across corporate and factory locations is desirable. 5. Key Deliverables Ensure uninterrupted IT operations across all locations. Maintain secure and reliable IT infrastructure. Ensure timely technical support to all employees. Maintain IT documentation, asset records and backup reports. Support implementation of new IT systems and digitalisation initiatives. Suggested recruitment advertisement Position: System Administrator Location: Hyderabad – Corporate Office Experience: 6 to 8 Years Qualification: BCA / B.Sc. IT / B.Tech IT / MCA or equivalent. We are looking for an experienced System Administrator to manage and maintain our company's IT infrastructure across corporate offices and manufacturing locations. Key Skills Required: Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft 365. LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewall and VPN. Hardware and software troubleshooting. Data backup, cybersecurity and disaster recovery. IT asset and vendor management. Candidates with experience in manufacturing organisations and multi-location IT infrastructure management will be preferred. Interested candidates may share their updated resumes along with current CTC, expected CTC and notice period. M

Ensure proper calibration, maintenance, and routine performance checks of analytical instruments. title: Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India
description:
Job Description | Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University About Cornerstone: At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness. About the role: Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys. As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You'll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you'll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal. This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You'll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You'll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone's own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product. The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company's future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life. This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas. Scope and Decision Rights: You own: Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators. You partner on: enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams). In this role, you will... Key Responsibilities: Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function. Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost. Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly. Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms. Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language. Architecture & Standards Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice. Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval. Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue. Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience. AI-Powered Experiences Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified. Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams. Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring. Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems. Integration & Execution Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal. Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management. Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team. Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use. Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards. Partnership & Leadership Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes. Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT. Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product. Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives. What Success Looks Like: First 30-60 days: current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway. By 6 months: unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience's needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics. By 9-12 months: single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale. Ongoing measures: front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness. You've Got What It Takes If You Have... Required Skills & Experience: 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools. Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes. Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics. A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams. Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI). Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar. AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost. Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level. Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day. Strongly Preferred: Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect. Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data. Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs. Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms. Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect). How You Work: Customer obsessed: you start from the learner's and the account's problem, not the tool. Innovate and transform: you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don't earn their place. Proactive leadership: you see the problem and act before you're asked. Get it done: you ship, measure, and iterate. Forward looking: you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been. Monitor service health and security events; tune alerting and dashboards. Partner with IAM, Cyber Security, Architecture, and application teams to deliver secure-by-design integrations. Strong understanding of authentication vs authorisation, identity lifecycle, and trust boundaries. Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles; contribute to operational readiness. Support audits and control testing; evidence compliance with security and regulatory requirements. Participate in on-call/incident response, problem management, and continuous improvement. 
 Essential Skills Proactive attitude to delivery Go getter and provides input into discussions to help drive things forward. Knowledge of Multi-Factor Authentication / Passwordless Authentication technology is required. Strong hands-on experience with federated protocols (OIDC/OAuth2/SAML). Experience with at least one IdP platform and troubleshooting tools. Strong understanding of authentication vs authorisation, identity lifecycle, and trust boundaries. Able to adapt to technology well and is confident in discussion. Presents well and can hold meaningful discussions and challenge where needed. Support PoC/Pilot testing and planning for rollout for new authentication patterns. Work with Architecture on production infrastructure design. Understanding of regulatory/security expectations (least privilege, auditability). Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cyber Security, or equivalent experience. This role will be responsible for managing employee relations cases, conducting workplace investigations, providing HR consulting support, ensuring compliance with employment laws and company policies, and analyzing trends to drive positive employee experiences and business outcomes.
 Employee Relations Case Management Manage end-to-end employee relations cases, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution. Maintain accurate and comprehensive case documentation. Interpret and apply company policies and employment laws to employee relations matters. Assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and escalate cases when necessary. Partner with employees, leaders, and HR stakeholders to resolve workplace concerns. 
 Employee Relations Consulting & Guidance Provide expert guidance to managers and HR partners on employee relations matters. Advise on corrective action plans, performance concerns, and disciplinary processes. Support involuntary termination processes and related documentation. Build strong relationships and credibility with business leaders and stakeholders. Deliver training and coaching on employee relations practices and HR processes. Support employee relations programs and organizational initiatives. 
 Workplace Investigations Conduct and manage investigations involving workplace concerns such as misconduct, harassment, discrimination, policy violations, and other employee complaints. Interview employees, managers, and relevant stakeholders to gather facts and documentation. Prepare investigation findings and recommend appropriate actions. Coach managers and HR partners on investigation best practices. Support implementation and communication of new or updated policies. 
 Reporting & Data Analysis Analyze employee relations trends, case volumes, and workplace concerns. Prepare reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders. Identify emerging issues and recommend proactive solutions. Utilize data insights to improve employee relations effectiveness and reduce organizational risk. 
 Audit & Compliance Support Support internal and external audits related to employment practices and compliance requirements. Respond to regulatory and compliance-related information requests. Ensure adherence to applicable labor laws, company policies, and compliance standards. 
 Workforce Change & Downsizing Support Assist leaders with workforce reduction and organizational change initiatives. Support impact assessments, documentation, employee communication, and separation processes. Coordinate severance-related activities and reporting requirements. Partner with HR, Legal, and business stakeholders throughout the process. 

 Required Qualifications Bachelor's /Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Employee Relations, Human Resources, Employment Law, or a related HR function. Experience conducting workplace investigations and managing complex employee relations cases. Strong knowledge of employment laws, disciplinary processes, and HR best practices. Experience advising managers on employee performance, conduct, and workplace issues. Proven ability to build effective cross-functional relationships across multiple levels and geographies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency with HR systems, case management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.

title: Network Administrator
description:
Job Description Network Administrator Role: Network Administrator
 Department: IT / Infrastructure
 Location: Campus
 Job Summary We are looking for a Network Administrator who will be responsible for maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting the campus network and ICT infrastructure. The role requires hands-on technical expertise to quickly identify and resolve issues related to Wi-Fi, LAN, CCTV, networking equipment, and other ICT devices , ensuring uninterrupted operations across the campus. Key Responsibilities 1. Network & Wi-Fi Management Monitor the campus Wi-Fi and LAN network to ensure stable and reliable connectivity. Identify and troubleshoot issues related to slow internet, connectivity drops, dead zones, access points, switches, routers, and network configuration . Diagnose network issues independently and implement appropriate solutions. Coordinate with the ISP/service providers for issues related to internet connectivity and bandwidth. Ensure all network equipment is properly configured and functioning. Conduct regular checks of network infrastructure and identify potential issues proactively. 2. CCTV & Surveillance Systems Monitor and troubleshoot CCTV-related issues across the campus. Resolve issues related to camera connectivity, recording, display, NVR/DVR, storage, cabling, and network connectivity . Ensure CCTV systems are operational and recordings are available when required. Coordinate with external CCTV vendors for hardware-level issues or replacements where necessary. 3. ICT Device Troubleshooting Provide first-level troubleshooting and technical support for campus ICT equipment. Troubleshoot issues related to projectors, TVs/displays, audio systems, microphones, speakers, video conferencing equipment, printers, and other ICT devices . Identify whether an issue is related to hardware, software, configuration, connectivity, or power supply and take appropriate corrective action. Ensure classroom and meeting-room ICT equipment is operational and ready for use. 4. Preventive Maintenance Conduct regular preventive checks of network and ICT infrastructure. Maintain an inventory of network equipment and ICT devices. Identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions. Maintain proper documentation of network configurations, equipment, repairs, and replacements. 5. Vendor & Service Coordination Coordinate with network, CCTV, ISP, and ICT equipment vendors whenever external support is required. Follow up with vendors to ensure issues are resolved within agreed timelines. Verify the resolution of issues before closing service requests. Required Skills & Qualifications Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking, Electronics, or a related field . 2–5 years of relevant experience in network administration or IT infrastructure support. Strong troubleshooting skills across Wi-Fi, LAN, routers, switches, access points, and basic network infrastructure . Hands-on knowledge of CCTV/NVR/DVR systems . Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, and network troubleshooting. Ability to troubleshoot ICT equipment such as displays, projectors, audio systems, and conference-room equipment. Good vendor coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently and respond quickly to on-ground technical issues. Key Competencies Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability Hands-on technical approach Ability to diagnose issues independently Quick response to critical network/ICT issues Preventive maintenance mindset Good communication and vendor-management skills Ability to manage multiple issues and prioritize based on operational impact Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Network/Wi-Fi uptime and stability Response and resolution time for network and ICT issues Timely resolution of CCTV and classroom ICT issues Reduction in recurring technical issues Preventive maintenance completion Vendor issues closed within agreed timelines Overall availability and readiness of campus ICT infrastructure

title: Civil Structural Engineer onshore
description:
Job Summary**

We are seeking a talented and experienced Civil Structural Engineer to join our onshore team at Cyient, Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, analysis, and evaluation of civil and structural components for various onshore projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and client specifications.

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform structural analysis and design of foundations, steel structures, concrete elements, and other civil components for onshore facilities, including industrial plants, power generation facilities, and infrastructure projects.
* Develop engineering drawings, specifications, and reports using relevant software and tools (e.g., AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS).
* Conduct site visits and inspections to assess existing conditions, gather data, and monitor construction progress.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including architects, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, and project managers, to ensure integrated and efficient project execution.
* Review and interpret technical documents, codes, and standards (e.g., AISC, ACI, ASCE, IBC) to ensure design integrity and compliance.
* Prepare technical proposals, cost estimates, and project schedules.
* Identify and resolve engineering challenges, providing innovative and cost-effective solutions.
* Participate in client meetings and presentations, effectively communicating technical information.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the professional development of the team.
* Adhere to company safety policies and procedures at all times.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution. Master's degree preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license is highly preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in civil and structural design for onshore projects.
* Proficiency in structural analysis and design software such as STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, or similar.
* Strong understanding of relevant building codes and industry standards (AISC, ACI, ASCE, IBC).
* Experience with AutoCAD and/or other drafting software.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required. 
 Roles and Responsibilities

• Can use codes under guidance
• Can lead the projects with team up to 10 associates

Support identification of assets affected by newly disclosed critical and high-risk vulnerabilities. Create, assign, and track remediation tickets to asset owners and support teams. Monitor remediation progress and follow up with stakeholders to support SLA compliance. Track program performance indicators and identify opportunities for remediation process improvement. Help maintain vulnerability management procedures, standards, documentation, and operating processes. Assist in improving vulnerability management workflows, automation opportunities, and reporting capabilities. Participate in recurring vulnerability review meetings with stakeholders.  Behaviors and Competencies: Problem Solving: Identifies vulnerabilities, remediation blockers, and process gaps while recommending practical solutions. Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams to drive vulnerability remediation and compliance efforts. Initiative: Proactively identifies opportunities to improve vulnerability management processes, reporting, and operational efficiency. Attention to Detail: Ensures vulnerability data, remediation status, asset information, and compliance documentation are accurate and complete. Organization: Manages multiple remediation initiatives simultaneously while maintaining established priorities and deadlines. Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned vulnerabilities and remediation tracking through resolution. Continuous Learning: Maintains awareness of emerging threats, CVEs, technologies, and cybersecurity best practices. Follow-Up: Consistently tracks remediation activities and escalates unresolved vulnerabilities when appropriate. 
 Skill Level Requirements: Understanding of vulnerability management concepts, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation processes. Familiarity with CVSS scoring, CVEs, vulnerability prioritization, and threat intelligence. Ability to analyze vulnerability scan results and identify remediation recommendations. Experience with Windows Server, Linux, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure technologies. Ability to create clear technical documentation and remediation guidance. Ability to communicate technical findings to various stakeholder groups. Experience using reporting and data analysis tools. Familiarity with compliance standards, including PCI DSS, CIS Controls, and security best practices. 
 External Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field. title: Logistics Manager
description:
Role Overview The Logistics Manager will manage the procurement, transportation, and delivery of agricultural machinery and silage across Cornexts supply network. The role involves coordinating machinery supplies from vendors to customers and procuring silage from fodder entrepreneurs for delivery to dairy farms. The incumbent will also oversee international shipments, transportation costs, delivery tracking, and accurate shipment documentation. Key Responsibilities 1. Machinery Procurement and Transportation Coordinate with approved machinery vendors for procurement, order confirmation, production readiness, and dispatch schedules. Ensure machinery specifications, quantities, prices, and delivery terms match approved purchase orders. Arrange suitable vehicles, loading equipment, and safe transportation of machinery to customers, warehouses, or project sites. Coordinate with the sales and service teams for customer delivery requirements, unloading arrangements, and installation readiness. Track shipments and resolve delays, shortages, transit damage, and delivery discrepancies. 2. Silage Procurement and Distribution Coordinate silage procurement from fodder entrepreneurs and approved suppliers based on customer demand and supply plans. Confirm availability, agreed pricing, bale quantities, weights, and dispatch readiness. Coordinate with production and quality teams to ensure silage meets approved quality and packaging requirements before dispatch. Plan timely deliveries to dairy farms, considering farm requirements, vehicle availability, loading capacity, and unloading schedules. Verify dispatched and received quantities and resolve weight differences, damaged bales, rejected material, or shortages. 3. Transporter and Vendor Management Identify, evaluate, and maintain a reliable network of transporters, machinery vendors, silage suppliers, and logistics partners. Negotiate freight rates and service terms within approved budgets. Plan routes, consolidate loads, and improve vehicle utilisation to control transportation costs. Monitor transporter performance against delivery timelines, safety requirements, and service commitments. Maintain alternative transport arrangements to manage urgent requirements and supply disruptions. 4. Documentation and Delivery Confirmation Verify purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, lorry receipts, and other applicable dispatch documents. Ensure shipment details—including consignee information, quantities, weights, vehicle details, and delivery addresses—are accurate and consistent across documents. Collect signed delivery acknowledgements or proof of delivery from customers and dairy farms. Maintain complete shipment records and coordinate with finance to reconcile freight bills, supplier invoices, advances, and payment discrepancies. Ensure applicable documentation is available before dispatch and escalate discrepancies for correction. 5. International Logistics Manage import and export logistics for machinery, components, and other company products. Coordinate with overseas vendors, customers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and insurance providers. Arrange and verify applicable shipping documents, including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or airway bills, certificates of origin, and customs documentation. Coordinate customs clearance, shipment insurance, port handling, and onward transportation. Monitor international shipment schedules and control freight, storage, demurrage, and detention costs. Work with finance and relevant specialists to ensure shipments follow applicable import/export requirements and agreed commercial terms. 6. Planning, Reporting, and Coordination Prepare procurement, dispatch, and delivery plans in coordination with sales, production, service, and finance teams. Maintain shipment trackers and provide timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders. Prepare periodic reports on logistics expenditure, pending deliveries, vendor performance, transit losses, and outstanding delivery acknowledgements. Develop and improve procedures for procurement coordination, dispatch, documentation, and delivery confirmation. Supervise logistics staff and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related discipline. Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience, with responsibility for end-to-end logistics operations. Experience in agricultural machinery, farm equipment, silage, animal feed, or related industries will be an advantage. Practical experience in machinery transportation, supplier coordination, and deliveries to rural locations. Working knowledge of international freight, customs clearance, shipping documentation, and Incoterms. Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP or logistics management systems. Required Skills Procurement coordination and vendor management. Freight negotiation and transportation cost control. Dispatch planning, shipment tracking, and problem-solving. Accurate documentation and record maintenance. Strong communication, negotiation, and team coordination. Ability to manage multiple shipments and urgent operational requirements. Key Performance Indicators On-time procurement, dispatch, and delivery. Freight cost control and vehicle utilisation. Accuracy and completeness of shipment documentation. Timely collection of delivery acknowledgements. Reduction in transit damage, shortages, and delivery complaints. Timely international shipment clearance and delivery. Timely reconciliation of supplier and transporter bills. Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to vendor locations, fodder entrepreneur sites, warehouses, customer locations, dairy farms, and ports as required

Key Skills: Scheduling,Dispatch scheduling,Management,Logistics operations,Coordination,Logistics,Logistics coordination,Logistics management

title: Opportunity For Senior Executive  Logistics
description:
Company Description: Beginning as a modest caf in 1953, Paradise Food Court Pvt Ltd. (Paradise Biryani) has grown into one of the most admired restaurant chains in the country. It is an iconic fixture in Hyderabad, recognized for serving the best Biryani and award-winning cuisine loved for its purity and taste. With multiple formats including cafes, bakeries, and restaurants, Paradise ensures top-notch quality and hygiene standards. Recognized by respected media for authentic Hyderabadi cuisine, Paradise is poised for growth, opening new outlets in several cities across India in the coming years. Role Objective 
 Paradise is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Executive Logistics to manage end-to-end logistics and transportation operations across its PAN India network. The role involves inbound and outbound logistics, route planning, dispatch coordination, cold chain management, transport vendor coordination, and timely delivery of goods to restaurants and inter-warehouse locations. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in food logistics, QSR distribution, or cold chain transportation, with a strong focus on operational efficiency, cost optimization, product quality, and compliance with food safety and transportation standards. 
 Roles and Responsibilities Logistics Planning and Execution: Plan, coordinate, and monitor inbound and outbound deliveries to ensure timely and accurate movement of goods across restaurants, warehouses, and Central Manufacturing Locations (CMLs). Route Planning and Optimization: Develop efficient delivery routes, optimize vehicle utilization, reduce transit time, and minimize transportation costs. Dispatch Coordination: Coordinate daily dispatch schedules, shipment documentation, loading, unloading, and vehicle movement to ensure smooth logistics operations. Cold Chain Management: Monitor temperature-controlled transportation and ensure the integrity, quality, and safety of food products throughout transit. Transport and Vendor Management: Coordinate with transporters, logistics vendors, and drivers to ensure vehicle availability, service quality, timely deliveries, and adherence to agreed service levels. Inter-Warehouse Transfers: Manage the movement of goods between warehouses, CMLs, and restaurants while ensuring proper documentation and inventory accuracy. Restaurant Coordination: Work closely with Area Managers, Branch Heads, Store Teams, and CML Teams to address delivery delays, shortages, damages, and other logistics-related issues. Cost and Budget Management: Monitor transportation expenses, analyze logistics costs, control operational expenditure, and identify opportunities for cost savings. Performance Monitoring: Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including on-time delivery, vehicle utilization, transportation cost, delivery accuracy, and vehicle turnaround time. description:
Manager, Business Performance - Amgen External Planning 

 Role Summary 
 The Manager, Business Performance drives strategic improvements to AXP processes and ways of working, while delivering data-driven insights across the organization. The role helps shape AXP's digital strategy and enables smarter planning and supply chains across internal and external manufacturing through analytics, AI, and technology. The Manager owns improvements to the AXP Process Framework across Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, and Enable. In partnership with the Business Delivery Office (BDO) and Amgen Digital and Technology teams, the role standardizes workflows, identifies process gaps, and advances digital transformation. The role works with Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain teams, Global Distribution, Contract Quality Management, Operations Finance, Global Planning, and AXP Regional Hubs. It supports performance visibility across commercial and pre-commercial supply, integrated business planning, operational excellence, digital adoption, and compliance. 

 Roles and Responsibilities 

 Improve and Govern AXP Processes 
 Own and improve the AXP Process Framework across Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, and Enable. Standardize end-to-end workflows, roles, and handoffs across functions, regions, and sites. Identify process gaps, risks, duplication, and unclear handoffs; maintain process maps, RACI matrices, work instructions, job aids, and guidance documents. Work with AXP Compliance and the BDO to manage changes to SOPs and approved documents. Apply Lean Business Systems and Operational Excellence methods to improve processes and ways of working. 

 Lead Continuous Improvement and Automation 
 Use process analysis and value stream mapping to identify and prioritize continuous improvement, automation, and quick-win projects. Develop business justifications that define expected benefits, ROI, cost avoidance, and cost savings. Track project outcomes and confirm whether expected benefits are achieved. 

 Advance Digital Transformation and Smart Supply Chains

Identify practical uses of data, analytics, AI, and automation to improve internal and external manufacturing, planning, and supply chain processes. Partner with Amgen Digital and Technology teams to define business needs and develop scalable solutions. Translate business needs into system and reporting requirements; support implementation, adoption, and ongoing monitoring of solutions. 

 Monitor Business and Financial Performance 
 Track AXP Supply Chain and Finance metrics with Operations Finance and Global Planning. Maintain and improve KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and metric definitions; analyze performance across commercial and pre-commercial supply. Identify important trends, variances, risks, and KPIs requiring immediate attention; share insights and coordinate follow-up actions with the appropriate owners. Support visibility of agreed measures, including cost to serve, productivity, capacity, inventory, logistics, and financial plan or forecast variances. Support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and forward 12-quarter strategy discussions. Present data and analysis clearly to support business decisions. 

 Partner Across AXP and Global Functions 
 Align priorities with the AXP Supply Execution Manager and BDO Manager. Partner with Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain teams, Global Distribution, Contract Quality Management, Operations Finance, Global Planning, and AXP Regional Hubs. Support integrated processes and systems across regions and functions, working effectively across the US, Europe, and JAPAC time zones. 

 Lead Projects and Develop Team Capability 
 Lead cross-functional projects and manage multiple priorities with minimal direction. Advise leaders on options, risks, and solutions for complex issues. Coach and develop team members; support capability building, succession planning, and engagement. Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

 Tools and Systems 
 Familiarity with modern supply chain and business performance tools is preferred: Supply chain and enterprise planning: SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis RapidResponse, or other enterprise planning systems. Process mapping: iGrafx, Microsoft Visio, or Lucidchart. Analytics and reporting: Tableau or similar business intelligence tools. Process management: process monitoring, process governance, and controlled documentation. 

 Basic Qualifications 
 Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience requirements: Doctorate degree and at least 3 years of Supply Chain, Business Analytics, or Operations experience; or Master's degree and at least 8 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of relevant experience. In addition, candidates must have at least 2 years of experience directly managing or leading projects or programs. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience leading cross-functional process standardization or improvement initiatives. Lean Six Sigma experience; Green Belt certification preferred. Strong analytical mindset and experience using data to identify business opportunities. Experience applying analytics, AI, or automation to supply chain processes. Ability to identify quick wins and develop business justifications, including ROI, cost avoidance, and cost savings. Experience in pharmaceutical or biotech supply chains and GMP-regulated environments. Understanding of internal and external manufacturing, including CMO/CDMO operations. Experience with KPI dashboards, performance reporting, or KPI governance. Experience supporting QBRs, IBP, or Long-Range Strategy cycles. Strong project management, communication, presentation, and financial skills, including cost to serve, productivity, and capacity. 

 Soft Skills 
 Growth mindset and willingness to learn, adapt, and improve. Uses sound judgment and is willing to take calculated risks to move work forward. Flexible and effective when collaborating across global time zones. Seeks feedback, reflects on it, and applies it to improve performance. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Constructive, accountable, and patient-focused attitude.

title: Natural Gas & NGL Value Chain
description:
Job Title: NATURAL GAS & NGL VALUE CHAIN 
 Domain : Oil & Gas - Downstream & Midstream 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
We are seeking a seasoned Consultant with deep expertise in natural gas and natural gas liquids (NGL) operations to partner with our clients on defining and executing value chain optimization strategies. The successful candidate will combine strong operational knowledge of gas handling and processing with advanced digital transformation capabilities translating complex operational realities into actionable strategic roadmaps, identifying digital gaps across the value chain, and delivering measurable commercial outcomes. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Strategic Vision & Initiative Roadmap 
 Define and articulate the strategic vision for value chain optimization aligned to the client's commercial and operational objectives. Develop a prioritized initiative roadmap spanning short-, medium-, and long-term horizons, covering upstream supply, midstream processing, and downstream distribution of natural gas and NGLs. Identify, scope, and champion quick winshigh-impact, low-effort opportunities that generate immediate value and build stakeholder confidence. Facilitate executive workshops and strategic alignment sessions to gain buy-in across operations, finance, IT, and commercial functions. Translate strategic ambitions into clear business cases with quantified value potential (cost reduction, margin improvement, throughput optimization).
 
 2. Value Chain Assessment & Optimization 
 Conduct end-to-end value chain analysis encompassing gas gathering, compression, treating & sweetening, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing. Assess NGL value chains including ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline streamsfrom separation and stabilization through to product delivery and offtake. Identify value leakage points, operational inefficiencies, scheduling bottlenecks, and commercial misalignments across the value chain. Benchmark client performance against industry best practices and recommend targeted interventions to close performance gaps. Model alternative value chain configurations and commercial structures (e.g., tolling vs. equity, spot vs. term) to maximize netback and margin capture.
 
 3. Systems & Data Landscape Assessment 
 Perform a structured assessment of the client's current technology landscapeincluding SCADA, DCS, ERP, scheduling, nomination, and measurement systems. Map data flows across the value chain, identifying data silos, manual handoffs, reporting gaps, and integration failures ("digital breaks"). Evaluate data quality, availability, and timeliness for operational decision-making, commercial settlement, and regulatory compliance. Develop a systems capability heat map and gap analysis to frame the digitalization opportunity. Review master data management (MDM) practices and data governance maturity in the context of gas measurement, allocation, and balancing.
 
 4. Digitalization Roadmap & Quick Wins 
 Identify and prioritize digitalization opportunitiesfrom process automation and real-time monitoring to advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and integrated planning tools. Define digital quick wins: automation of manual workflows, dashboard consolidation, IoT-enabled measurement upgrades, or improved scheduling visibility. Develop a phased digitalization roadmap with clear milestones, technology recommendations, resource requirements, and expected ROI. Advise on fit-for-purpose technology choices (e.g., gas nomination platforms, production allocation software, digital twin capabilities, cloud-based optimization tools). Collaborate with IT and OT teams to assess integration architecture and propose practical pathways from current to target-state digital infrastructure. 
 5. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Delivery 
 Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders at operational, commercial, and executive levels. Lead and contribute to project workstreams, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and meet quality standards. Prepare and present high-quality findings, recommendations, and roadmaps through client-ready reports and executive briefings. Support change management by coaching client teams through new processes, tools, and operating models. Participate in business development activities including proposal development, client scoping discussions, and practice thought leadership.
 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: 
Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated expertise across the natural gas value chain: gathering, compression, processing, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing.
 Strong working knowledge of NGL products (ethane, propane, butanes, pentanes+), their processing requirements, quality specifications, and market dynamics.
 Proven track record in supply chain and/or value chain analysis, optimization, or transformation projects.
 Experience conducting digital maturity assessments, systems landscape reviews, or operational technology (OT/IT) integration projects.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in quantitative modeling and data analysis tools.
 Excellent communication and facilitation skills; ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
 
 Preferred : 
MBA or advanced degree in Business, Strategy, or a related field.
Experience with gas scheduling, nomination, and balancing systems (e.g., Quorum, WinTrak, OpenTicket, or equivalent). 
Familiarity with digital transformation frameworks and methodologies (agile, design thinking, lean). 
Exposure to AI/ML applications in production optimization, demand forecasting, or anomaly detection within upstream/midstream gas operations.

 Knowledge of regulatory frameworks governing natural gas pipelines, tariffs, and NGL transportation (FERC, state/provincial regimes).
 
 CORE COMPETENCIES: 
 
NG & NGL Operations Value Chain, Optimization Strategic Roadmapping, Digital Transformation, Systems & Data Assessment, Stakeholder Management Commercial, Acumen Data Analytics, Executive Communication 
 WHAT WE OFFER : 
High-impact engagements with leading energy companies across the natural gas value chain. 
Collaborative, expert team environment with opportunities for mentorship and professional development. 
Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including performance-based incentives. 
Exposure to cutting-edge digital tools and methodologies shaping the future of energy operations. 
Flexible working arrangements with a hybrid on-site/remote model (client travel required).

 We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. Employer Branding & Market Intelligence Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement. Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements. title: Supply Chain & Warehouse Manager (Food Processing Unit)
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and strategic Supply Chain & Warehouse Manager to lead end-to-end supply chain operations at our food processing unit in Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will be responsible for procurement of raw materials and packaging, inventory planning, warehouse management, logistics, and distribution. You will ensure uninterrupted material availability for production, maintain optimal inventory levels, and drive cost efficiencies while upholding food safety and FIFO/FEFO standards in storage. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Supply Chain Planning & Procurement: Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned with production plans and sales forecasts. Plan and procure raw materials (flours, starches, proteins, oils, seasonings) and packaging materials in coordination with the R&D and QA teams. Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable suppliers; negotiate pricing, terms, and lead times. Monitor market trends and commodity price fluctuations to optimize procurement costs. Coordinate with Production, QA, and R&D teams to ensure material specifications and approvals are met. 2. Inventory & Demand Planning: Drive S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning) processes with Sales, Production, and Finance teams. Maintain optimal inventory levels (RM, PM, WIP, FG) to avoid stockouts and excess inventory. Monitor inventory turns, ageing, and slow-moving/non-moving stock; implement corrective actions. Ensure accurate MRP (Material Requirement Planning) and production scheduling support. 3. Warehouse Management: Oversee all warehouse operations receiving, storage, issuance, and dispatch of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods. Ensure strict adherence to FIFO/FEFO , food safety, and GMP standards in storage areas. Maintain warehouse layout, space utilization, and cold/ambient storage conditions as per product requirements. Implement and monitor WMS (Warehouse Management System) and barcode/stock accuracy systems. Conduct regular cycle counts, physical stock verification, and reconciliation of discrepancies. 4. Logistics & Distribution: Manage inbound and outbound logistics transporter selection, freight negotiation, and route optimization. Ensure timely dispatch of finished goods to distributors, modern trade, and institutional customers. Track shipments, resolve transit issues, and monitor OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance. Handle documentation for GST, e-way bills, and statutory compliance related to logistics. 5. Compliance, Cost & Team Management: Ensure compliance with FSSAI storage norms, statutory requirements, and internal audit standards. Drive cost reduction initiatives across procurement, warehousing, and logistics. Lead, train, and mentor the supply chain and warehouse teams. Maintain MIS reports on procurement, inventory, dispatch, and supply chain KPIs. Key Requirements (Must-Have) Education: MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, or a related field Experience: 4 to 8 years of experience in supply chain and warehouse management within the Food Processing / FMCG industry . Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of MRP, inventory planning, warehouse operations, and food safety storage norms (FIFO/FEFO, GMP). Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/Microsoft Dynamics) and WMS; strong MS Excel skills. Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with FSSAI storage norms, GST/e-way bill compliance, and logistics documentation. Strong Experience in Handling Logistics & Transport Companies in Hyderabad. Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Excellent planning, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Proven leadership and team management capabilities. Effective communication and cross-functional coordination skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing environment.

title: Dynamics 365 Engineer
description:
Position: LA/AC
Experience: 9 yrs to 12 Yrs
Category: Software Development
Main location: Hyderabad.

Employment Type: Full time

Dynamics 365 Engineer UKI SAPDecomEnabler

Role Purpose
 CGI is looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineer supporting the modernisation of enterprise applications and the progressive transition of business capabilities and integrations away from legacy SAP dependent services.

 The Dynamics 365 Engineer will design, build, test and maintain high quality solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, working within a cross functional engineering squad alongside Product, Architecture, QA, Operations and other technology teams.
 The role requires strong Dynamics engineering capability together with experience in integrations, APIs, Power Platform, Azure services and modern software engineering practices.
 Within the SAPDecomEnabler context, the engineer will work with relevant application and integration teams to understand existing SAP dependencies and help deliver Dynamics based capabilities and integrations required to support the target state architecture. Required qualifications to be successful in this role: Key Responsibilities
 1. Dynamics 365 Engineering

 . Design, develop, test and maintain scalable solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365.
 . Configure and customise Dynamics applications to meet agreed business requirements.
 . Develop high quality, secure and maintainable solutions in accordance with established engineering standards.
 . Develop and maintain Dynamics components including: Entities / tables Plugins Workflows Business logic Web resources Model driven applications Custom controls Integrations
 . Analyse technical requirements and translate them into robust Dynamics solutions.
 . Ensure solutions meet agreed functional and non functional requirements.

 2. SAP Decommissioning Enablement

 . Work within the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to support the transition of relevant capabilities and dependencies away from legacy SAP services.
 . Collaborate with SAP, application, architecture and business teams to understand existing process and integration dependencies.
 . Identify where Dynamics 365 capabilities form part of the target state solution.
 . Develop or enhance Dynamics functionality required to support processes transitioning away from SAP.
 . Support the replacement or decoupling of SAP dependent interfaces where Dynamics is part of the target architecture.
 . Work with integration teams to ensure downstream and upstream dependencies are understood and addressed.
 . Support migration, cutover, validation and stabilisation activities associated with the transition.
 . Ensure replacement capabilities are operationally ready before associated legacy dependencies are retired.

 3. Dynamics 365 & Power Platform

 . Develop solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform alongside Dynamics 365.
 . Build and enhance solutions using: Power Apps Power Automate Dataverse Model driven applications
 . Automate business processes and workflows using appropriate Power Platform capabilities.
 . Develop reusable components and patterns where appropriate.
 . Ensure Power Platform solutions follow agreed governance, security and development standards.

 4. Integration Engineering

 . Design and develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems.
 . Build and consume REST APIs and web services.
 . Support integration with legacy/SAP applications during transition.
 . Work with Azure based integration technologies where appropriate.
 . Develop solutions using technologies such as: Azure Functions Azure Logic Apps Azure Service Bus APIs / Web Services
 . Support event driven and asynchronous integration patterns.
 . Ensure integrations are secure, resilient, observable and supportable.
 . Troubleshoot complex integration and data flow issues across platforms.

 5. Software Development
 Depending on the Dynamics solution area, develop and maintain solutions using relevant technologies including:

 . C#
 . .NET
 . JavaScript
 . TypeScript
 . Dynamics plugins
 . Workflow assemblies
 . FetchXML
 . Web resources
 . APIs and web services

 Apply appropriate coding standards, design patterns and engineering practices to ensure solutions are maintainable and scalable.
 6. CI/CD & DevOps

 . Work with modern source control and CI/CD practices.
 . Maintain application code and configuration within appropriate version control repositories.
 . Build and support automated deployment pipelines for Dynamics and Power Platform solutions.
 . Promote controlled and repeatable deployment across environments.
 . Participate in code reviews and peer reviews.
 . Implement automated testing where appropriate.
 . Support continuous improvement of development and deployment practices.
 . Ensure releases comply with Centrica change, security and engineering controls.

 7. Testing & Quality Engineering

 . Take ownership of the quality of delivered Dynamics solutions.
 . Develop and execute appropriate unit and technical testing.
 . Support integration, system and user acceptance testing.
 . Participate in peer/code reviews.
 . Investigate and resolve defects proactively.
 . Ensure technical solutions satisfy functional and non functional requirements.
 . Support regression testing during SAP transition and decommissioning activities.
 . Validate that changes do not adversely affect existing business processes and integrations.

 8. Security & Compliance

 . Develop solutions in accordance with Centrica security and data protection requirements.
 . Apply appropriate Dynamics security roles and access controls.
 . Ensure customer and business data is handled responsibly.
 . Follow secure software development practices.
 . Consider security, privacy and compliance requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
 . Work with Security and Architecture teams where design approval or specialist input is required.

 9. Performance, Resilience & Scalability

 . Design Dynamics solutions with appropriate consideration for: Performance Availability Scalability Resilience Maintainability Supportability
 . Identify and resolve performance issues.
 . Ensure integrations can handle expected business volumes.
 . Avoid unnecessary customisation where standard Dynamics/Power Platform capabilities can meet requirements effectively.
 . Contribute to continuous platform optimisation.

 10. Live Service Support

 . Support Dynamics solutions after deployment into production.
 . Participate in incident investigation and technical troubleshooting.
 . Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
 . Resolve defects and production problems.
 . Contribute to ongoing platform and service improvements.
 . Ensure appropriate technical documentation and support knowledge is maintained.
 . Support hypercare following major migrations or SAP decommissioning releases.

 11. Agile & Cross Functional Delivery

 . Work as part of the UKI SAPDecomEnabler cross functional squad.
 . Collaborate closely with: Product Owners Software Engineers SAP SMEs Solution/Technical Architects QA / Quality Engineering Security Infrastructure Integration teams Operations Business stakeholders
 . Participate in sprint planning, refinement, stand ups, retrospectives and technical design discussions.
 . Take ownership of agreed work items through to completion.
 . Raise risks, blockers and dependencies early.
 . Contribute positively to team delivery and continuous improvement.

 Mandatory Technical Skills
 The successful candidate should have strong hands on experience in:

 . Microsoft Dynamics 365
 . Dynamics 365 configuration and customisation
 . C# / .NET
 . JavaScript and/or TypeScript
 . Dynamics plugins and workflows
 . Power Apps
 . Power Automate
 . Dataverse
 . REST APIs / Web APIs / Web Services
 . Enterprise system integration
 . Source control and CI/CD
 . Automated testing and code review
 . Secure software engineering practices

 The candidate should also demonstrate:

 . Experience working as a software engineer within a modern cross functional Agile/product squad.
 . Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 . Understanding of non functional requirements including performance, resilience and scalability.
 . Experience supporting live enterprise applications.
 . Strong troubleshooting and problem solving capability.
 . Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Desirable Technical Skills
 Experience in the following would be advantageous:

 . Azure Functions
 . Azure Logic Apps
 . Azure Service Bus
 . Azure DevOps
 . Event driven architectures
 . Asynchronous processing
 . PCF Controls
 . FetchXML
 . Workflow Assemblies
 . Dynamics Web Resources
 . Power Platform governance
 . Application monitoring and observability
 . Cloud native integration patterns

 SAP Transformation Experience Highly Desirable
 For the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, candidates with the following experience would be particularly valuable:

 . Previous involvement in SAP transformation, migration or decommissioning programmes.
 . Experience replacing business capabilities previously delivered through SAP.
 . Experience decoupling enterprise applications from SAP integrations.
 . Understanding of SAP to Dynamics integration patterns.
 . Experience with enterprise data migration and interface transition.
 . Experience identifying upstream/downstream system dependencies.
 . Experience supporting technical cutover and hypercare.
 . Understanding of controlled legacy system retirement.

 Deep SAP development expertise is not necessarily required; the primary requirement is Dynamics engineering capability combined with the ability to work effectively with SAP and integration teams during the transition.
 Dynamics Product Experience
 Depending on the specific capability being transitioned, relevant experience may include one or more of:

 . Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)
 . Dynamics 365 Customer Service
 . Dynamics 365 Field Service
 . Dynamics 365 Sales
 . Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)
 . Power Platform / Dataverse

 Candidates do not necessarily need deep expertise across every Dynamics product. The appropriate Dynamics specialisation should align with the specific business capability being transitioned by the squad.
 Certifications Desirable
 Relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, including:

 . Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Developer
 . Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer
 . Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect
 . Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant certifications
 . Relevant Azure certifications

 Key Competencies
 Dynamics EngineeringStrong hands on capability to configure, customise, develop and support enterprise grade Dynamics solutions.
 Integration Thinking: Understands how Dynamics interacts with APIs, Azure services, legacy platforms and other enterprise applications.
 Problem Solving Able to investigate complex application and integration issues and identify practical technical solutions.
 Engineering Quality: Produces secure, maintainable and well-tested code and takes ownership of quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
 Collaboration: Works effectively with Product, Architecture, SAP, QA, Security, Operations and other engineering teams.
 Ownership: Takes responsibility for agreed deliverables, proactively identifies risks and follows issues through to resolution.
 Continuous Improvement Actively improves engineering practices, automation, maintainability and platform capability.
 Expected Outcomes
 The Dynamics 365 Engineer will help the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to:

 . Deliver Dynamics capabilities required by the target state architecture.
 . Reduce business process and application dependencies on legacy SAP services.
 . Build secure and scalable Dynamics solutions.
 . Establish robust integrations between Dynamics and strategic enterprise platforms.
 . Automate business processes using Dynamics and Power Platform.
 . Improve maintainability through modern software engineering and DevOps practices.
 . Ensure replacement services are production ready before legacy dependencies are retired.
 . Support safe migration, cutover and stabilisation.
 . Contribute to Centrica's wider technology modernisation objectives.

 Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is a hands on Dynamics engineer rather than purely a Dynamics functional consultant.
 They should be comfortable working across Dynamics configuration, custom development, Power Platform and enterprise integrations, while collaborating with architects, SAP teams and business stakeholders.
 For this particular squad, the strongest candidate would combine:
 Dynamics 365 + C#/.NET + Power Platform + APIs/Integration + Azure + modern engineering practices
 with previous exposure to SAP transformation/decommissioning or complex legacy modernisation programmes.
 Candidates with backgrounds such as Dynamics 365 Developer, Dynamics Engineer, CRM Developer, Power Platform/Dynamics Developer or Full Stack D365 Engineer would be particularly relevant.

description:
Job Summary 
 Give us an opportunity to find the next career move for you. SA Technologies Inc. is hiring for Systems Engineer in Hyderabad. Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Job Type: Permanent. The Systems Engineer is a qualified, practitioner responsible for applying knowledge and expertise within the field of systems engineering. This role involves overseeing and executing interdependent systems engineering activities, including detailed requirements decomposition, system design, integration, and problem solving, requiring sophisticated analytical techniques. The Systems Engineer manages tasks of moderate scope, works independently on problems of diverse scope, and creates innovative solutions based on analysis and evaluation of various factors. This position involves significant interaction with internal and external stakeholders and requires adaptive communication styles for different audiences. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Execute the development, management, and allocation of system requirements to system elements and subsystems, overseeing the refinement of lower level requirements flowed down to other engineering disciplines. Perform complex analyses and trade studies to guide system concept selection, ensuring system architecture and design align with operational concepts. Create and control systems engineering artifacts such as Requirements Verification Traceability Matrixes RVTM, Interface Control Documents ICD, architecture diagrams, design documents, system and service workflows, test cases, test plans, test procedures, and test reports. description:

 We are seeking an experienced SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) Consultant to design, develop, and support enterprise integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP systems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SAP Integration Suite (CPI), integration design, API development, message mappings, scripting, and cloud integration technologies. The role requires close collaboration with functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing integration solutions. 
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Independently design, develop, configure, and deploy SAP CPI integration flows based on functional and technical requirements. Develop complex integration scenarios using SAP CPI adapters, message mappings, value mappings, XSLT mappings, and Groovy/JavaScript scripting. Build and maintain integrations between SAP and non-SAP applications using SOAP, REST, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Salesforce, and other standard connectors. Execute unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and troubleshoot integration issues to ensure stable and high-performing interfaces. Collaborate with SAP Functional Consultants, technical teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver integration solutions. Monitor SAP CPI integration runtimes, message processing, and proactively resolve interface failures, exceptions, and performance bottlenecks. Enhance and optimize existing integration interfaces to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including Technical Design Documents (TDD), interface specifications, deployment guides, test cases, and operational manuals. Support deployments across Cloud and Hybrid/On-Premise environments and coordinate with infrastructure teams for connectivity, security certificates, and environment setup. Ensure compliance with SAP integration best practices, governance standards, security policies, and organizational development guidelines. 
 

 Required Skills 
 Strong experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (SAP CPI) / SAP Integration Suite. Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST APIs, OData, IDoc, RFC, XML, JSON, and XSLT. Experience in developing Groovy Scripts and JavaScript within SAP CPI. Strong knowledge of Message Mapping, Value Mapping, Content Modifier, Router, Splitter, Gather, Exception Subprocess, and Process Direct adapters. Experience with SAP Cloud Connector, API Management, and Event-Based Integrations. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP IBP, SAP C4C, or other SAP applications. Good understanding of integration monitoring, security certificates, authentication mechanisms (OAuth, Basic, JWT), and error handling. Experience with transport management, version control, and deployment processes.

title: Distinguished Engineer
description:
Company Overview 
 AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website 
 Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview 
 Job Role 
 Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the companys ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software. 
 Key Responsibilities Company-level product direction. Work with Product, the CTO, VP of Engineering and customer-facing leaders to identify the technical capabilities that matter most to customer value and product differentiation. Use customer evidence and market understanding to shape investment options, build-versus-buy decisions and long-term platform direction. Cross-product architecture. Guide architecture across product boundaries, shared services and integrations. Simplify dependencies, clarify interfaces and reduce systemic risks. Define staged modernisation plans that protect existing customers while enabling future capabilities. Establish decision principles with accountable product and engineering owners. Hands-on execution. Personally design and implement critical components, reference solutions and technically demanding capabilities. Lead complex initiatives through validation and rollout. Resolve the highest-impact systemic engineering problems without becoming the default owner of every difficult implementation task. Production AI leadership. Guide reliable AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices. Establish evaluation methods, tenant and data boundaries, safe tool execution, oversight, observability and cost controls appropriate to each use case. Demonstrate where AI improves outcomes and where simpler approaches are preferable. Engineering capability. Mentor Principal Engineers, architects and senior technical leaders. Establish reusable practices for secure, reliable and maintainable delivery. Improve the quality of engineering decisions across teams and build leadership capacity that persists beyond your direct involvement. Executive influence and accountability. Communicate technical trade-offs in terms of customer impact, investment and risk. Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them. Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls. Pride of Ownership 
 We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes. 
 Experience & Desired Skills 
 Required Skills (Mandatory) 15+ years delivering complex enterprise software, with sustained evidence of company-wide or multi-product technical impact. Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture. Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use. Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs. Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code. Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation.
