Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection. Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory. What success looks like Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries. title: CyberArk Engineer - PAM, Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM & PowerShell
description:
Job Summary Synechron is seeking an experienced CyberArk Engineer with 4+ years of CyberArk administration and engineering experience to manage, enhance, and support the organizations Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The role will focus on CyberArk implementation, privileged account onboarding, enterprise integrations, automation, platform maintenance, and operational support. This position contributes to business objectives by protecting privileged accounts, strengthening access controls, supporting compliance requirements, and reducing risks associated with unauthorized or unmanaged privileged access. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required CyberArk Vault: Hands-on administration, configuration, support, and maintenance experience using the organizations supported version. Password Vault Web Access (PVWA): Experience managing administrative access, user workflows, account access, and platform operations. Central Policy Manager (CPM): Experience configuring password policies, account management, password rotation, and reconciliation. Privileged Session Manager (PSM): Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting privileged sessions. Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA): Experience supporting privileged access monitoring, analytics, alerts, and investigation activities. Active Directory and LDAP: Experience integrating CyberArk with directory services and enterprise identity platforms. Windows Server and Linux Administration: Experience onboarding and supporting privileged accounts across Windows, Linux, and Unix environments. PowerShell and Scripting: Experience developing scripts for automation, administration, validation, and operational support. REST APIs and CyberArk APIs: Experience using APIs to support integrations, automation, account management, or monitoring activities. IAM and Security Tools: Practical understanding of identity and access management technologies, privileged access controls, authentication, authorization, and security operations. Defect, Incident, and Change Management Tools: Experience using approved tools to document incidents, service requests, changes, investigations, and operational activities. Preferred CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): Experience with administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege controls, or support. Cloud Identity and Infrastructure Platforms: Experience integrating CyberArk with Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Automation Tools: Exposure to automation frameworks, infrastructure automation, configuration management, or deployment tools. CyberArk Defender Certification: Preferred. CyberArk Sentry Certification: Preferred. CISSP, CISM, or Security+ Certification: Preferred. Security and Compliance Tools: Experience supporting audit, compliance, vulnerability management, security assessment, or privileged access review activities. Overall Responsibilities Administer, configure, monitor, and support the CyberArk PAM platform, including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Onboard privileged accounts, servers, applications, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, and other supported systems into CyberArk. Design and implement PAM solutions aligned with approved security standards, access control requirements, operational procedures, and compliance expectations. Configure password management, password rotation, reconciliation, session management, monitoring, alerting, and privileged account controls. Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, and other enterprise identity and access platforms. Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or CyberArk APIs to improve onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational efficiency. Perform CyberArk upgrades, patches, health checks, configuration reviews, maintenance, and platform optimization activities. Troubleshoot CyberArk platform issues and provide L2/L3 support within agreed service and response requirements. Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Identity, and other technical teams to onboard systems and resolve access-related issues. Participate in incident response, privileged access investigations, session reviews, and remediation activities when required. Support audits, compliance reviews, security assessments, access certifications, and evidence collection. Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, configuration records, and support procedures. Track platform health, onboarding progress, operational risks, defects, and improvement opportunities. Apply efficient and sustainable operational practices by reducing manual processing, reusing automation, and optimizing platform resources where applicable. Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential PowerShell scripting for CyberArk administration, account onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational automation. Basic Python scripting for automation, data processing, validation, monitoring, or support activities. Working knowledge of REST APIs and CyberArk APIs for integrations and automated operations. Ability to interpret scripts, API responses, configuration parameters, and platform logs. Preferred Experience with additional scripting or automation languages used in enterprise infrastructure and security operations. Experience developing reusable automation utilities for large-scale account onboarding and platform administration. Databases and Data Management Essential Understanding of privileged account data, account ownership, platform assignments, safe or vault structures, access permissions, password policies, and reconciliation data. Ability to validate account inventories, onboarding information, access records, session data, and audit evidence. Experience onboarding databases and managing privileged database accounts through CyberArk. Understanding of data confidentiality, retention, integrity, and controlled access requirements. Preferred Experience supporting database platforms in regulated or large enterprise environments. Exposure to reporting, dashboards, data extraction, or operational metrics related to PAM activities. Cloud Technologies Essential Experience onboarding or supporting privileged accounts and systems in cloud environments. Understanding of cloud identity, access, administrative accounts, service accounts, and privileged access risks. Experience working with at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Preferred Experience integrating CyberArk with cloud identity services, cloud infrastructure, virtual machines, applications, and platform services. Exposure to cloud-native security controls, secrets management, and privileged access governance. Frameworks and Libraries Essential CyberArk PAM platform capabilities, including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Understanding of PAM principles, least-privilege access, password rotation, session isolation, session monitoring, account discovery, and access governance. Ability to configure platform policies, account management processes, authentication methods, access workflows, and monitoring controls. Preferred CyberArk EPM administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege management, or operational support. Exposure to identity governance, secrets management, privileged task automation, or related security frameworks. Development Tools and Methodologies Essential Experience with CyberArk implementation, administration, onboarding, integration, maintenance, and operational support. Experience performing platform upgrades, patches, health checks, troubleshooting, configuration reviews, and incident resolution. Experience using incident, change, problem, defect, and service management processes. Ability to create runbooks, operational procedures, knowledge articles, implementation records, and support documentation. Experience collaborating with infrastructure, cloud, application, identity, security operations, and audit teams. Preferred Experience supporting CyberArk deployments in large enterprise environments. Exposure to Agile, IT service management, automation-led operations, or structured security engineering methodologies. Experience contributing to platform roadmaps, operational improvements, implementation planning, and service reporting. Security Protocols Essential Strong understanding of Privileged Access Management principles and security controls. Practical knowledge of least privilege, role-based access, separation of duties, account lifecycle management, password rotation, session monitoring, and privileged activity auditing. Experience with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, authentication, authorization, and identity integrations. Knowledge of security standards and control frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, Essential Eight, and APRA CPS 234. Ability to support PCI-DSS requirements and privileged access governance controls. Understanding of incident response, privileged access investigations, audit evidence, access reviews, and remediation tracking. Preferred Experience working in regulated environments, including Banking and Financial Services. Exposure to security assessments, control testing, compliance attestations, vulnerability remediation, and audit responses. Experience implementing enhanced monitoring and analytics for high-risk privileged accounts and sessions. Experience Requirements Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in CyberArk administration and engineering . Demonstrated experience administering and supporting CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Experience onboarding Windows, Linux, Unix, databases, applications, network devices, and cloud platforms into CyberArk. Experience designing and implementing PAM solutions aligned with security standards, access governance requirements, and operational controls. Experience integrating CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, and other enterprise identity platforms. Experience using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or CyberArk APIs for automation and operational support. Experience performing CyberArk upgrades, patches, health checks, troubleshooting, maintenance, and L2/L3 support. Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, security assessments, incident response, and privileged access investigations. Banking or Financial Services experience is preferred, particularly experience with APRA CPS 234, PCI-DSS, and privileged access governance requirements. Candidates may qualify through equivalent experience in PAM engineering, IAM administration, security operations, or identity security roles where they can demonstrate comparable CyberArk implementation, onboarding, integration, and support outcomes. Day-to-Day Activities Administer CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA; onboard privileged accounts and systems; configure policies; and perform platform health checks. Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Identity teams to assess onboarding requirements, resolve access issues, and coordinate integrations. Develop PowerShell, Python, REST API, or CyberArk API automations; troubleshoot L2/L3 incidents; and support upgrades, patches, maintenance, and investigations. Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, audit evidence, support records, and implementation deliverables while making operational decisions within approved PAM and security standards. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Minimum 4 years of professional experience in CyberArk administration and engineering, including implementation, onboarding, integration, and operational support. CyberArk Defender and CyberArk Sentry certifications are preferred; CISSP, CISM, or Security+ certifications are also preferred. Relevant training in CyberArk PAM, IAM, privileged access governance, security operations, scripting, cloud security, and applicable compliance standards is preferred. Commitment to continuous professional development through CyberArk platform updates, security training, certifications, compliance learning, and evolving PAM practices. Professional Competencies Apply structured problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot CyberArk issues, investigate privileged access activity, and identify sustainable resolutions. Collaborate effectively with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Identity, audit, and compliance teams to deliver secure access solutions. Communicate technical findings, risks, onboarding requirements, incidents, control gaps, and remediation activities clearly to relevant stakeholders. Adapt to changing CyberArk capabilities, enterprise architectures, cloud environments, security threats, compliance requirements, and operational priorities. Identify opportunities to improve PAM coverage, automation, monitoring, onboarding efficiency, control effectiveness, and responsible use of platform resources. Manage time and priorities across platform administration, onboarding, incident response, support activities, documentation, maintenance, audit requests, and delivery commitments. CyberArk implementation, onboarding, and operational support experience within a large enterprise environment is highly desirable. title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quality Engineer: Fabrication & Heavy Engineering 
 Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control
 Function: Fabrication & Heavy Engineering Production
 Designation: Quality Engineer
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Plant Head
 Location: Manufacturing Unit
 Experience: 3 - 7 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering 
 Job Purpose: The Quality Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that all fabrication, welding, machining, assembly and structural manufacturing activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, Quality Plans, ITPs and applicable standards. The role will work closely with Production, Engineering, PPC, Projects and Supply Chain teams to prevent quality issues, minimize rework and rejection, and ensure timely inspection and clearance of fabricated components and assemblies. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities: 1. Fabrication & Production Quality Carry out stage-wise and final inspection of fabricated components, structures and assemblies. Ensure fabrication is carried out as per approved engineering drawings, BOM, specifications and customer requirements . Inspect material cutting, fit-up, welding, drilling, bending, machining, assembly and finishing activities. Verify critical dimensions, tolerances, alignment, straightness, squareness, flatness and overall geometry. Ensure proper identification and traceability of raw materials and fabricated components. Monitor production processes to identify and prevent potential quality deviations. 2. Welding Quality Perform inspection of joint preparation, fit-up, root gap, weld size, weld profile and finished welds . Ensure welding activities are performed according to approved WPS/PQR and qualified welder requirements , wherever applicable. Verify welding consumables, storage conditions and usage controls. Conduct visual inspection of weld joints and coordinate required NDT activities. Identify welding defects and coordinate corrective action with Production. Maintain welding and inspection records as per project/customer requirements. 3. Dimensional & Final Inspection Perform dimensional inspections using instruments such as: Vernier calipers Micrometers Height gauges Measuring tapes Weld gauges Spirit levels Other relevant inspection instruments Ensure measuring instruments are within valid calibration status. Conduct final inspection before surface treatment, painting, assembly, packing and dispatch. Ensure all identified observations are closed before final product clearance. 4. Quality Documentation Prepare and maintain: Inspection reports Dimensional inspection reports Stage inspection records Quality check sheets ITP/QAP records NCR reports Rework/rejection records NDT reports Calibration records Final quality dossiers, wherever applicable Ensure proper documentation and traceability for customer and third-party inspections. 5. NCR, Rejection & Rework Control Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for deviations from drawings, specifications or processes. Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for disposition and closure of NCRs. Monitor rejection, rework and repair trends . Conduct root cause analysis for recurring quality defects. Support implementation of corrective and preventive actions using tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis and CAPA . Drive reduction in Cost of Poor Quality through process improvement. 6. Engineering & Drawing Coordination Review fabrication drawings and understand GD&T, dimensions, tolerances, welding symbols and fabrication requirements . Highlight discrepancies or manufacturing concerns to the Engineering team before production. Ensure latest approved drawings and revisions are being followed on the shop floor. Coordinate technical clarification between Engineering, Production and Quality . 7. Production Quality Improvement Conduct regular shop-floor quality audits. Identify process gaps and recommend preventive quality controls. Participate in first-piece and first-off inspections for new components/products. Support development of inspection checkpoints for critical fabrication processes. Train and guide production supervisors, welders, fitters and operators regarding quality requirements and common defects. Promote a Right First Time quality culture in fabrication. 8. Customer / Third-Party Inspection Coordinate customer and Third-Party Inspection activities as required. Ensure products are internally inspected and cleared before offering them for customer/TPI inspection. Prepare required inspection documents and reports. Coordinate closure of inspection observations and punch points. 
 Key Performance Indicators KPIs Reduction in rejection and rework percentage First Pass Yield / Right First Time performance Number of internal and customer NCRs Timely closure of NCRs Customer inspection acceptance rate Adherence to inspection schedules Reduction in repeat quality issues Calibration compliance Quality documentation accuracy and completeness Reduction in Cost of Poor Quality Timely clearance of material without impacting production schedules 
 Technical Knowledge Required Candidate should have good knowledge of: Heavy engineering and structural fabrication Fabrication drawings and engineering drawings Welding processes such as SMAW, GMAW/MIG, GTAW/TIG and SAW , as relevant to the plant Welding symbols and weld inspection WPS, PQR and welder qualification concepts NDT methods such as VT, PT, MT, UT and RT Dimensional inspection techniques Measuring and inspection instruments GD&T fundamentals Material identification and traceability Surface preparation and painting inspection basics NCR/CAPA and Root Cause Analysis ISO-based Quality Management Systems 5S and continuous improvement practices 
 Preferred Skills Strong understanding of fabrication and welding quality Ability to read and independently interpret complex engineering drawings Strong shop-floor problem-solving abilities Good coordination with Production and Engineering personnel Ability to identify defects and recommend practical corrective actions Good documentation and report-writing skills Working knowledge of MS Excel, ERP/SAP and quality documentation systems Ability to work under production and dispatch timelines without compromising quality requirements 
 Desired Candidate Profile We are looking for a hands-on Quality Engineer with strong exposure to fabrication and heavy engineering manufacturing. The candidate should be capable of independently handling shop-floor inspections, welding quality, dimensional inspection, NCR management, quality documentation and final product clearance . The individual should work proactively with Engineering and Production teams to prevent defects rather than only identifying defects after production . 
 Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in manufacturing of any of the following will be preferred: Heavy fabricated structures Structural steel fabrication Gantries and road furniture structures FOB structures Telecom / infrastructure structures Defence fabrication Large welded assemblies Industrial equipment and engineered-to-order products

title: Parent Relationship Manager
description:
Function: Parent Relationship Management Reports into: Zonal Senior Manager Parent Relationship Management Location: On-campus, embedded with the batch (specific NIAT campus) Deployment type: I ndividual contributor 
 Experience 
 1-2 years minimum ideally in a people-facing or trust-building role Education: Any graduate (bachelor's degree) 
 Role Summary The Parent Relationship Manager is the single, non-academic point of contact for the parents of a mapped batch of roughly 300 students on campus. This is a junior role, but not a first job someone who already carries some poise in a people-facing seat, is comfortable holding a hard conversation with an anxious parent, and takes ownership of a concern until it is actually resolved, not just logged. You will be the first person a parent turns to for anything about their child's experience at NIAT: attendance, grades, hostel life, fees, or simply needing to be heard and kept informed. 
 Key Responsibilities Single point of contact — every mapped parent knows exactly one name to go to for any concern about their ward's experience at NIAT — nothing goes unanswered Triage & resolution — log, categorise, and route every concern to the right owner (academics, facilities, finance, or the campus Student Relationship Manager) with an SLA, track it to closure, and escalate the moment it breaches Proactive updates — run a standing cadence of attendance, grade, and engagement updates so parents hear it from NIAT first, not from their child Parent education — inform and educate parents on programs, new-economy career paths, and how they can reinforce the right things at home Trust building — build and protect the parent's confidence in NIAT, especially in a difficult or emotionally charged conversation Tracker discipline — maintain a live issue tracker for the cohort and share a weekly dashboard — open concerns, SLA breaches, trust/NPS movement — as the working sync artifact with Program Ops 

 What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas Parent trust / NPS: NPS of mapped parent cohort First response time: Time to acknowledge a raised concern Resolution TAT: Average time to concern closure SLA breach rate: % of concerns escalated beyond SLA Update coverage: % of mapped parents sent the scheduled attendance/grade update Education reach: % of mapped parents who engaged with newsletter/education content Campus Connect participation: % of mapped parents attending a scheduled campus walk-in 
 Who We're Looking For 1–2 years of experience in a people-facing, trust-building role — this is not a first job Excellent verbal and written communication, and fluency in the local language of the campus Natural empathy and active listening — able to hear an anxious or upset parent out fully before responding Calm and mature under pressure — doesn't let a tense conversation escalate, and doesn't over-promise Discretion with sensitive family information — treats every case as confidential Proactive and self-starting — logs, follows up, and closes loops without being chased Comfortable with basic tracker/spreadsheet discipline and a weekly reporting rhythm Willing to be based on campus and work the academic calendar — this is not a remote or hybrid role. 
 Good to Have Prior experience specifically in a parent- or family-facing role — school front office, admissions counselling, or guest relations Familiarity with the campus's local community and culture

title: GTM Engineer
description:
The GTM Engineer owns the architecture and health of Quisitive's marketing execution engine: the platforms, integrations, automation logic, and data models that turn GTM strategy into a repeatable, scalable flywheel. This role goes beyond configuring out-of-the-box marketing automation features - it requires connecting systems together via APIs, custom connectors, and webhook-based integrations; building custom workflows and automations (e.g., using Power Automate); and building and managing AI-driven agents that extend what the platforms can do natively. "Agentic workflows" here means creating agents using low-code tools like Copilot Studio, orchestrating workflows within ZoomInfo Marketing, and building other automations using Power Platform, Zapier, or similar solutions, rather than custom-coded, general-purpose AI development. This is a systems-thinking and integration-building role, not a data-engineering one: it does not require Python, SQL, or Clay-style scripting. What it does require is curiosity - the instinct to ask "why does this work this way" and "where will this break at 10x volume," and the technical range to actually go build the fix. 
 Qualifications Required 5+ years in marketing operations/RevOps with a focus on systems and automation architecture, not just execution Hands-on experience building workflows/automations in Power Automate (or similar), including the use of custom connectors and webhook-based integrations to connect systems that don't natively talk to each other Experience connecting systems via APIs, custom connectors, or webhooks (native or custom-built) - beyond just using pre-built, out-of-the-box integrations Experience building AI agents using low-code tools such as Copilot Studio, and orchestrating automated workflows across platforms like ZoomInfo Marketing, Power Platform, Zapier, or similar solutions Demonstrated experience designing - not just running - impactful B2B lead scoring, segmentation models, and trigger-based workflows Strong systems-thinking mindset: comfortable questioning why a process works the way it does, and identifying where it will break at scale Experience with CRM/marketing automation integrations and platform migrations Preferred Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights Journeys), Dynamics 365 CRM Power BI or similar reporting/BI tools Account based marketing systems such as 6Sense or ZoomInfo Marketing Experience leading a platform migration or stack consolidation Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio), plus Zapier or similar workflow automation tools Not Required Python, SQL, Clay, or general-purpose software development - this role is about systems integration, workflow/agent building, and architecture thinking, not data engineering Success Metrics Automation maturity (% of campaigns running on triggers/agents vs. manual builds) Pipeline contribution from automated programs Number and business impact of systems successfully integrated via API/workflow automation Attribution accuracy and reporting reliability Reduction in manual processes across the team

title: VIDEO Editor  Telugu
description:
VIDEO EDITOR TELUGU A creative and skilled Video Editor who understands short-form content, Telugu internet culture, memes, humour, satire and political communication, and can turn briefs, ideas and raw footage into engaging and impactful video content. Responsibilities Edit Reels, short-form videos, meme videos, political content and other social media content. Edit speeches, interviews, news clips, campaign videos, parody videos and other digital content. Create video content using original and repurposed footage. Take a brief, understand the team's needs and specifications, and translate it into effective video communication. Develop and review scripts and raw material for videos wherever required. Trim footage segments and put together sequences with logical sequencing, strong pacing and smooth running. Create rough cuts and final cuts based on the requirements. Add and effectively use music, dialogues, graphics, subtitles, text, sound effects, transitions and visual effects wherever required. Create strong hooks, pacing, transitions and visual storytelling to keep viewers engaged and improve audience retention. Understand and effectively use Telugu meme formats, humour, satire, internet trends and cultural references. Create engaging political and social-media content that is relevant to the target audience. Work closely with content writers, designers and creative teams to execute ideas and creative briefs in a fast-paced work environment. Consult and coordinate with stakeholders across various teams and incorporate feedback into final outputs. Consistently create impactful communication collaterals across various mediums. Stay updated with current video-editing trends, viral formats, AI video tools, new content styles, editing technologies and industry best practices, and implement them to improve efficiency and output quality. Handle multiple projects simultaneously and deliver quality work within tight deadlines. Requirements 2127 years old. 1–8 years of work experience in an art/design or video-editing environment, preferably with an advertising agency (ATL/digital), brand or startup. Strong command of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects . Proficiency in CapCut or similar editing software . Experience with Final Cut is an advantage. Hands-on experience with AI tools for video creation, editing and content production. Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and CorelDRAW. Good understanding of Telugu language and Telugu meme culture. Good awareness of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and national politics. Strong understanding of short-form video, audience retention and current content trends. Strong sense of timing, humour, visual storytelling, music and aesthetics. Ability to create engaging content from raw footage, scripts and basic creative briefs. Ability to translate a brief into well-crafted communication content. Familiarity with special effects, animation, 3D and compositing. Keen eye for aesthetics, visual quality and attention to detail. Solid knowledge of design and visual principles. Creative mind with strong storytelling skills. Fast, creative and enthusiastic, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and under pressure. Strong multitasking skills and the ability to work methodically and meet deadlines. Previous experience in political, meme, news or social media video editing is a plus. Should have experience creating posts, ads or banners for social media in a previous role. Editing machine/desktop is mandatory. P.S. This is a contractual role till June 2027.

Welcome to Frontline Managed Services where innovation, technology, and efficiency converge to redefine the landscape of IT, Financial, and Administrative Managed Services for legal and professional service firms. As pioneers in the industry, we are driven by a relentless commitment to excellence. 
 Join Our Team and Be a Catalyst for Change! We don't just follow industry standards; we set them. Our dynamic environment thrives on pushing boundaries and embracing challenges. We are more than a workplace; we are a community of forward-thinkers dedicated to shaping the future. 
 Position Overview The Senior FP&A Analyst is responsible for supporting the company's financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic decision-making processes. This role requires advanced financial modeling skills, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights. The analyst will partner with leaders across Finance and business functions to improve financial performance, support growth initiatives, and drive data-driven decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities Financial Planning & Analysis Develop and maintain annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial plans. Perform monthly financial analysis, including variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year. Prepare executive-level financial reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and recommend improvement opportunities. Financial Modeling Build and maintain sophisticated financial models supporting revenue, profitability, cash flow, headcount, and strategic initiatives. Develop scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and what-if models to evaluate business decisions. Support pricing analyses, investment decisions, capital allocation, and business case development. Create models to evaluate acquisitions, new service offerings, and strategic investments as needed. Business Partnership Partner with business leaders to understand operational drivers and financial impacts. Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives and operational improvement projects. Assist department leaders in managing budgets and identifying opportunities to improve financial performance. Reporting & Analytics Produce monthly management reporting packages and KPI dashboards. Analyze trends in revenue, margins, operating expenses, and cash flow. Develop automated reporting solutions using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. Ensure data integrity across financial systems and reporting platforms. Process Improvement Improve budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes through automation and standardization. Support implementation and enhancement of FP&A tools and financial systems. Identify opportunities to streamline reporting and improve analytical capabilities. AI-Enabled ways of working Actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate modelling, variance analysis, deck creation and reporting workflows Identify and pilot opportunities to automate manual FP&A process (data pulls, recurring reports, first-draft commentary) using AI and scripting. Bring an experimenters mindset- comfortable evaluating new tools and pushing the team towards modern, efficient workflows rather than legacy spreadsheet grind. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. Minimum 6 years of experience in Corporate FP&A, Financial Analysis, or Corporate Finance. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and financial modeling. Experience building integrated three-statement financial models. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP/FP&A systems. Strong understanding of financial statements and corporate finance principles. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications CA, MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus. Experience in technology, SaaS, managed services, or professional services industries. Experience with SQL or Python for financial analytics is preferred. Experience supporting private equity-backed organizations is a plus. 
 Key Competencies Advanced financial modeling and valuation Forecasting and budgeting Business and financial analysis Strategic thinking Executive Communication and presentation skills Attention to detail and accuracy Data visualization and dashboard development Process improvement mindset Collaboration and business partnership

**Job Description**
* We are building a shared Agentic AI Platform that enables teams across the enterprise to design, deploy, and operate AI\-powered agents and workflows safely, consistently, and at scale.
* This role is for a builder–architect, someone with software and systems foundations who can operate hands\-on while also shaping architectural direction across teams.
* You will design and build core agentic AI platform capabilities while actively ensuring teams adopt shared primitives rather than creating fragmented, one\-oﬀ solutions.
* The role combines hands\-on engineering, Platform architecture, and cross\-enterprise influence, with a emphasis on reuse, cohesion, and long\-term sustainability.
* You will be based in Hyderabad and reporting to Director Engineering.
* This is Individual contributor role ( Non Managerial ).
* What you'll do here:
* Design and build foundational platform capabilities for agentic AI systems, including orchestration, lifecycle management, memory patterns, runtime policy and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Establish agent discovery, registration, and reuse mechanisms (e.g., registries, marketplaces, protocol integration) as shared platform capabilities.

* Design secure\-by\-default architectures that embed governance, policy enforcement, auditability, and access control into agentic systems and AI workflows.
* You will build reusable AI workflow primitives that teams can adopt consistently across the enterprise.
* Partner with enterprise teams (e.g., Cloud, Security, ITSM etc.) to integrate AI workflows into existing enterprise systems and platforms.
* Maintain a bird's\-eye view of Agentic AI and AI Workflow initiatives across the enterprise, identifying the opportunities to reduce fragmentation and promote convergence.
* Mentor engineers and influence technical direction through hands\-on contribution, design leadership, and clear reasoning.


**Qualifications**
**Must have skills:**
* 8\+ years of experience in designing, building, and operating cloud\-native software systems in production environments, with depth in platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems.

* Experience designing or operating systems that incorporate LLMs or AI models as core components, including managing model interaction, control flow, and failure modes.
* Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Scala) for building backend services, frameworks, or SDKs.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including compute, networking, storage, and security primitives.
* Demonstrated experience owning and evolving shared platform architectures over time, including setting boundaries, managing tradeoffs, and adapting designs as scale and requirements change.
* Proven ability to drive architectural alignment across teams through technical influence, design reviews, reference architectures, and hands\-on collaboration rather than formal authority.
* Exposure to agent frameworks, multi\-agent systems, or AI orchestration tools.
* Experience designing systems with explicit state management, lifecycle control, and correctness guarantees across asynchronous and long\-running workflows.
* Experience working with orchestration systems, workflow engines, or event\-driven architectures.
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and delegated access patterns, including OAuth 2\.0 and related standards, as applied to service\-to\-service and user\-mediated workflows.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, shared services, or reusable runtime frameworks.
* Staying hands\-on with emerging AI capabilities and tools that informs system and platform design decisions.

* You think beyond individual teams and care deeply about ecosystem health.

title: Systems and Master Data Management Specialist
description:
ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases, and make peoples lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond whats known today. ABOUT THE ROLE The Systems and Master Data Management Manager is responsible for leading a team that enables Engineering, Facilities, EHS, and EOS operations through the governance, administration, and continuous improvement of business-critical systems, master data, and supporting business processes. The team serves as the bridge between Business and Technology, ensuring systems and data are reliable, compliant, scalable, and aligned with operational and enterprise objectives. This role is responsible for maintaining system integrity, enabling business process standardization, governing master data, supporting technology integrations, and ensuring users can effectively leverage systems to drive operational performance, compliance, and business outcomes. This role owns governance and operational oversight for key enterprise applications including SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, CMMS/EAM platforms, Cority, Sphera, Enablon, and other Engineering, Facilities, and EHS systems. The manager is accountable for ensuring systems remain operational, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture, governance standards, and FAIR data principles. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Systems and Master Data Management, this role partners closely with Technology, Data Analytics, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, Facilities, and EHS stakeholders to deliver integrated system and data capabilities that support operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and long-term digital transformation strategies. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Builds and leads a high-performing team responsible for enterprise systems administration, master data management, governance, and operational support across Engineering, Facilities, EHS, and EOS domains. Owns governance, operational health, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of business-critical applications including SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, CMMS/EAM platforms, Cority, Sphera, Enablon, and related enterprise systems. Establishes and governs master data standards, ownership, stewardship models, lifecycle processes, and data quality controls to ensure trusted, consistent, and compliant business data. Leads SAP S/4HANA and enterprise transformation initiatives by ensuring data readiness, migration governance, master data quality, system integration readiness, and sustainable operating processes. Oversees system administration activities including access management, security controls, incident management, change management, release support, compliance monitoring, and operational support processes. Ensures data extracted from enterprise systems is complete, accurate, traceable, reconciled, and free from deficiencies before being consumed by downstream business functions, analytics platforms, and reporting solutions. Establishes governance capabilities utilizing Collibra to manage business glossaries, metadata, data lineage, stewardship workflows, ownership models, policies, controls, and data quality monitoring processes. Partners with Technology, Data Engineering, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, Facilities, and EHS stakeholders to align systems, master data, integrations, and governance capabilities with enterprise priorities. Supports enterprise integrations, FAIR data principles, data traceability, and sustainable business processes that enable operational effectiveness and informed decision-making. Drives continuous improvement initiatives focused on system reliability, governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, user experience, and business process standardization. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 9 - 13 years of experience in Master Data Management, Systems Management, Enterprise Applications, Data Governance, Data Quality, or related disciplines. Hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), and enterprise system integrations. Experience supporting CMMS/EAM platforms, Engineering systems, Asset Management systems, and enterprise operational applications. Experience managing master data standards, governance processes, data quality initiatives, and stewardship programs. Experience performing data extraction, ETL development, data transformation, validation, reconciliation, and lineage management activities. Strong understanding of data governance principles, metadata management, data quality controls, and master data lifecycle management. Experience delivering governed, traceable, and high-quality enterprise data assets for downstream consumption by reporting, analytics, integration, and operational systems. Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable systems and data solutions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, Collibra, SAP EAM/PM, CMMS, Maximo, or similar enterprise Engineering and Asset Management platforms. Experience supporting S/4HANA migration programs, master data conversion, data cleansing, and data readiness initiatives. Strong knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, data quality, stewardship, and lifecycle management practices. Experience with EHS systems such as Cority, Sphera, Enablon, INCA, or similar platforms. Understanding of enterprise integrations, ETL processes, data lineage, metadata management, and traceability requirements. Experience establishing governance controls, reconciliation processes, and audit-ready data management practices. Knowledge of Clean Core principles, enterprise architecture standards, and regulated system governance. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Experience partnering with Technology, Operations, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, EHS, and Business teams in global environments. Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement, support change management initiatives, and ensure delivery of high-quality, governed, and defect-free data. PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS: Professional certifications in SAP S/4HANA , SAP MDG , SAP EAM/PM , CDMP , or related disciplines such as Data Governance, Data Quality, Asset Management, Information Management, and Enterprise Systems Administration are advantageous and considered a plus. Please contact us to request accommodation. Work Hours Work hours and shift requirements may vary based on business needs. Flexibility to work across different shifts may be required.

title: Sr. Manager /AGM _ Direct & Capex Procurement & Contracts
description:
Role & responsibilities : 
 1. Landscaping Procurement & Contract Management : 
 Manage procurement of landscaping materials, plants, trees, garden equipment, red soil, irrigation-related materials, and other landscaping requirements. Finalize suitable contractors for Hardscape and Softscape supply and execution work. Identify,evaluate, and develop reliable landscaping contractors and suppliers. Negotiate competitive rates, commercial terms, delivery schedules, payment terms, and execution conditions. Coordinate with Projects, Planning, Design, and Landscape teams to understand requirements and ensure timely execution. Monitor contractor performance, quality, progress, billing, variations, and completion of works. 
 2. Marble & Stone Procurement : 
 Manage end-to-end procurement of marble, granite, natural stones, and other stone-related materials. Identify and develop reliable sources, quarries, manufacturers, processors, and suppliers. Conduct market surveys and rate benchmarking to ensure competitive sourcing. Negotiate rates considering quality, quantity, wastage, transportation, processing,polishing, installation, and other associated costs. Ensure proper material selection, technical approvals, inspection, quality, and timely delivery. Monitor marble and stone inventory and facilitate inter-project utilization wherever feasible. Develop alternate sources to ensure continuity of supply and reduce dependency on individual vendors. 
 3. Interior Works Club Houses & Marketing Offices: 
 Manage procurement and contracting for interior works of Club Houses, Marketing Offices, Corporate Offices, and other project facilities. Handle procurement and execution of: False Ceiling Flooring Partitions Doors Lighting Fixtures Glass Railings Faade Works Dcor Items Carpets Stainless Steel Railings POP Works Internal Painting Other Interior Finishing Works Coordinate with Design, Architecture, Projects, Marketing, and other stakeholders for finalization of specifications, drawings, BOQs, and scope of work. Obtain competitive quotations and finalize vendors/contractors within approved budgets and timelines. Ensure proper coordination between design requirements, procurement, and site execution. 
 4. Capex Equipment Procurement : 
 Manage end-to-end procurement of Capital Equipment, Machinery, and other Capex requirements for projects and operations. Evaluate technical and commercial proposals from multiple OEMs suppliers. Conduct techno-commercial evaluation and detailed negotiations. Ensure optimum lifecycle cost considering purchase price, operating cost,maintenance, warranty, and after-sales support. Coordinate with Finance, Projects, P&M, Technical, and other concerned teams for budget approvals and procurement. Ensure timely delivery, installation, commissioning, testing, and handover of equipment. Monitor warranty, AMC/CMC, after-sales service, and supplier performance. 
 5. Contract Management: 
 Manage end-to-end contracts for landscaping, interior works, marble installation,specialized works, and other assigned contracts. Prepare, review, and finalize BOQs, Scope of Work, commercial terms, rate contracts, Work Orders, and agreements. Ensure clear definition of scope, specifications, quantities, timelines, payment terms, retention, LD, warranty, performance obligations, and other contractual conditions. Monitor contractor performance against agreed scope, cost, quality, and timelines. Review contractor bills, measurements, variations, deviations, and additional claims. Control and negotiate variations to minimize cost impact. Ensure timely closure of contracts, including final measurements, final bills,recoveries, warranties, and other contractual obligations. Resolve commercial and contractual issues in coordination with concerned departments and management. 
 6. Vendor Development & Management: 
 Develop a strong, reliable, and competitive vendor/contractor base. Identify new vendors and alternate sources for critical and high-value requirements. Conduct vendor evaluation, qualification, negotiations, rate benchmarking, and performance reviews. Ensure multiple sources are developed for critical materials and specialized works. Monitor vendor performance against Quality, Cost, Delivery, Service, and Compliance parameters. Maintain professional vendor relationships while ensuring strict adherence to company commercial policies. 
 7. Cost Control & Commercial Management: 
 Drive cost savings through competitive bidding, negotiations, market benchmarking, alternate sourcing, value engineering, and long-term rate contracts. Ensure procurement and contracts remain within approved budgets and management guidelines. Analyse market trends, price movements, and supply conditions and provide recommendations to management. Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or project requirements. Control variations, additional costs, and commercial deviations during contract execution. Maintain proper documentation and commercial records for all procurement and contracts. 
 8. Coordination, Reporting & MIS: 
 Coordinate closely with Projects, Planning, Design, Architecture, Marketing, Finance, P&M, Stores, and Management. Monitor procurement and contract status against project requirements and committed timelines. Track pending PRs, enquiries, quotations, negotiations, approvals, purchase orders, work orders, deliveries, and contract closures. Prepare periodic MIS covering: Procurement Status Cost Savings Pending Requirements Vendor/Contractor Status Contract Progress Variations and Claims Capex Procurement Status Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, approval procedures, SAP processes, and internal controls.
